data.page_subtitle: Canadian immigration advice in English and Tamil.
data.story_content:
Immigration decisions affect where you live, work and build your family’s future. Understanding your options and what an application requires can make those decisions easier.

Anitha Gabriel founded Velox Immigration Services Inc. to provide clear advice and careful application support. Her own immigration experience informs how she works with clients: listening to their concerns, explaining the requirements and helping them understand their next steps.

Velox means swift in Latin. For us, it reflects the importance of responding promptly and keeping work moving while giving each case the attention it needs.
data.founder_content:
Anitha Gabriel is the founder of Velox Immigration Services Inc. and a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant, registration number R1034239.

She provides advice and representation on Canadian immigration and citizenship matters, including study permits, work permits, visitor visas, permanent residence and family sponsorship.

Anitha takes time to understand each client’s circumstances before recommending a course of action. She explains the available options and discusses potential concerns so clients can make informed decisions.

Consultations are available in English and Tamil.

Anitha operates her Canadian practice through Velox Immigration Services Inc. She also works as a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant for Velox Immigration Services Private Limited in Chennai, India.

faq_items.question: What are the most common pathways to immigrate to Canada?
faq_items.answer: The most common pathways include Express Entry (for skilled workers), Provincial Nominee Programs, Family Sponsorship, Study Permits leading to permanent residency, and Business Immigration programs.

faq_items.question: Why should I hire an immigration consultant?
faq_items.answer: Immigration processes can be complex and time-consuming, with requirements changing frequently. A licensed consultant ensures your application is prepared correctly, avoiding costly delays or rejections. We provide strategic advice tailored to your specific situation, guide you through document preparation, and advocate on your behalf throughout the process.
